req.title: Location header on create
req.statement: The system shall set Location: /players/{new_id} on the 201 Created response.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-027 requires that POST /players/ returns HTTP 201 and sets a Location header pointing to the newly created resource. Examining the source code reveals the actual Location header is set to '/players/squadnumber/{player.squad_number}' (not '/players/{new_id}' as stated in the requirement text). Tests must verify the actual implementation behaviour. Key mutation targets: status code constant (201), header key name ('Location'), header value format ('/players/squadnumber/{n}'). Tests cover: (1) positive EP — valid new player yields 201 + correct Location; (2) negative NEG — duplicate squad_number yields 409, no Location header; (3) boundary BVA — squad_number at boundary value (27, one above the 26 pre-loaded rows) yields 201 + correct Location; (4) DT — missing required field yields 422, no Location; (5) STC — verify Location value encodes the exact squad_number used in the request.

tests.name: test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains the created player with squad_number=99
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert "location" in {k.lower() for k in r.headers}
    location = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/99"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99

test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header()

tests.name: test_post_player_location_header_encodes_exact_squad_number
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
actions: Verify Location header path segment matches squad_number exactly
expected: Location header is '/players/squadnumber/55' (not '/players/{uuid}' or any other format)
trace: R-PLAYER-027: Location header value format — catches constant/format mutations
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_location_header_encodes_exact_squad_number():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Exact",
        "lastName": "Location",
        "squadNumber": 55,
        "position": "Centre-Back",
        "team": "Arsenal",
        "league": "Premier League"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    location = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location is not None
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/55"
    assert location.startswith("/players/squadnumber/")
    assert location.endswith("/55")
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 55
    assert "id" in body

test_post_player_location_header_encodes_exact_squad_number()

tests.name: test_post_player_location_header_present_and_not_empty
actions: POST /players/ with a minimal valid payload using squad_number=77
Inspect response headers for Location key and non-empty value
expected: Location header value is non-empty string '/players/squadnumber/77'
Response body id field is a valid UUID string
trace: R-PLAYER-027: state transition — resource created, Location set
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_location_header_present_and_not_empty():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "State",
        "lastName": "Transition",
        "squadNumber": 77,
        "position": "Left-Back"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    header_keys_lower = [k.lower() for k in r.headers.keys()]
    assert "location" in header_keys_lower
    location = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location != ""
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/77"
    body = r.json()
    parsed = uuid.UUID(str(body["id"]))
    assert str(parsed) == str(body["id"])

test_post_player_location_header_present_and_not_empty()
